_anonymised_copy: Anonymised copy of a registered protocol file: internal provenance fields (storage ids, hosts, resource accounting, internal review notes) were removed or redacted. Embedded sha256 values refer to the original registered file and do not match this copy.
nature: REGISTERED protocol of the question-normalizer method track. A LoRA normalizer N on Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct maps a question to benchmark-style wording and is placed in front of the UNCHANGED frozen pipeline (Rules, Ranker, Parser, Reader). Registered before any normalizer training, generation or scoring.
question: Does putting a question normalizer (trained on the 5% training list only) in front of the unchanged pipeline reduce the Hits@1 loss under LLM rewording (R3, secondary per the R3 rule) and raise Hits@1 on rewrites, at each fitting level 5 and 100, and what does it cost on the original wording of the official test split?

parent_documents.R2: rule (+ A1 86c40986..., A2 26093e75...), set, predictions, freeze

status_at_registration.outputs: None: no normalizer adapter, no normalizer output, no pipeline run on normalized text, no score of any normalizer configuration exists.
status_at_registration.work_before_registration: Read the R3 rule and amendments, the R3 probe report, the frozen code (kpct parser / guided code, R3 code); extracted question TEXT of train.json (5% list), dev.json and test.json from a local copy of the dataset (sha256 train 89ce10b4..., dev ad0dfe7c..., test d9bf3bf2...; answers not read); built the training pairs and the text-only item files below; measured the guard pass rate on the TRAINING pairs only (paraphrase -> its own original): after splitting 'A and B' name runs and removing possessives, 17,034 / 17,146 pass, 112 fall back (adjective/demonym forms, e.g. 'South African' -> 'of South Africa'); read the 4090 LoRA throughput of an earlier track (parser seed track: 1.12 s/step at train_tok 768, peak 22.7 GB).
status_at_registration.known_numbers: The frozen arms' dev ORIG / dev paraphrase Hits@1 (R3 probe report) and the full-test k% results (aggregate) are known to the designers. R3 Hits are not known to anyone (R3 rule).

test_reuse: Official MultiTQ test split (questions/test.json sha256 d9bf3bf23b489ecc76c7940510c718260a42350d934a6edc1c1c7efcd5238fee), reused; R3 / R1 / R2 are rewrites of official test questions. Nothing is trained or selected on test, R1, R2 or R3.

normalizer.model: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct (HF cache on the second GPU host), LoRA

training_data.source: the 5% training list only (k05_s0, n = 19,339, sha256 0a840365...); training paraphrases = multitq_train5pct_paraphrase_set.json (Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ, 18,000 generated = registered-order prefix, A3), mechanically valid rows only (17,146)
training_data.pairs: (Qwen paraphrase -> original question) for the 17,146 mech_ok rows + identity pairs (original -> original) for the SAME 17,146 questions; ratio paraphrase : identity = 1 : 1; 34,292 examples (nm_common.training_pairs)
training_data.never_used: dev, test, R1, R2, R3 questions; the 854 mechanically invalid and the 1,339 not generated k05_s0 questions

normalizer.prompt: one user turn = nm_common.N_HEAD + '\nQuestion: {question}\n' (sha256 of head|template f5ae9ba67421649de4be82ea26e7bf22c894a66dacdbfc34c1a63cfdfa39daeb); Llama-3.1 chat template with the fixed date_string '26 Jul 2024' (as the frozen Reader/Parser); target = the original question text + <|eot_id|>
normalizer.recipe: frozen Reader/Parser LoRA recipe (pk_train.py / gk_train.py loop): r 16, alpha 32, dropout 0.05 on q,k,v,o,gate,up,down; AdamW lr 2e-4, weight decay 0, cosine schedule, 3% warm-up, grad clip 1.0, effective batch 16, bf16; loss on answer tokens only; seed 0 (LoRA init and data order: per-epoch permutation default_rng(1000*seed + 7 + epoch), length-sorted chunks of 64 batches); max length 512 (short sequences); micro-batch padded-token limit 768 (24 GB card); no gradient checkpointing; peft 0.21.2, transformers 5.13.1 (tkgqa-gpu:latest on the second GPU host)
normalizer.epochs_and_checkpoints: E = 2 (the recipe's E_max for the 5% list); adapters saved at epoch 0.5, 1 and 2 = the three candidate checkpoints. Registered epoch rule after a 40-step dry run (adapter discarded): E = 2 if the projected two-epoch training time <= 1.5 h and spent + projection <= 4.5 - 1.0, else E = 1 (checkpoints ep0.5, ep1)
normalizer.inference: vLLM 0.10.2 (image vllm/vllm-openai:v0.10.2 on the second GPU host RTX 4090), bf16, LoRARequest, max_model_len 512, gpu_memory_utilization 0.85, greedy (temperature 0, seed 0), max 128 new tokens, stop at <|eot_id|>; prompt token ids of 50 training inputs must equal the training-time ids (else exit, tokenizer mismatch). Same engine and settings for dev, test, R1, R2, R3.

guard.definition: nm_common.guard / final_text, gold-free and text-only, applied to the raw output y for input x. If y (stripped) equals x: unchanged. Otherwise y is used only if it passes: W well-formed / parseable (non-empty, one line, ends with '?', len(y) <= 2.5 len(x), finish_reason 'stop'); E names (every name piece of x = rob_common.protected_chunks with possessive removed and 'A and B' runs split, verbatim in y); T dates (frozen mtq_lib.parse_time: the time string of x verbatim in y with the same granularity and value; no time added if x has none); otherwise FALLBACK to x.
guard.grid: guard variant in {A = W+E+T, B = A + no new name pieces in y}; overlap floor tau in {0 (off), 0.2} (token Jaccard(x, y) >= tau); 4 guard settings (nm_common.GUARD_GRID)
guard.fallback_text: the input question itself (so the pipeline sees exactly what the baseline saw)

identity_reuse.rule: nm_common.reuse_source: if the final text equals the input, the arm's prediction is its FROZEN prediction on that input (official full-test file / dev_sel2000 selection file / frozen R1, R2, R3 rewrite predictions / frozen DEV_ACCEPTED paraphrase predictions); if a rewrite is normalized to exactly its own original question, the frozen ORIG prediction is used; every other final text is run through the unchanged frozen pipeline. Justification: the pipeline is a function of the question text (R1 rule arms.synthetic_quids), the structural rebuild is exact (R3 I1 = 1.000), and the R3 rule already uses frozen predictions as the ORIG reference.
identity_reuse.consequence: the per-question contrast is exactly 0 for every question whose text the normalizer leaves unchanged or sends back by fallback
identity_reuse.identity_control: 200 control rows per root (synthetic quid 10q+0, original text) run with the normalized rows: dev controls = sorted(dev_sel2000)[i], i in default_rng([20261118, 21]).choice(2000, 200, replace=False); test controls = sorted(test quids)[i], i in default_rng([20261118, 22]).choice(54584, 200, replace=False). Structural RULE and S top-1 agreement with the frozen files >= 0.995 at k05_s0 and k100 (rob_build I1), else STOP_PIPELINE_DRIFT (one logged bug fix allowed). G / P top-1 agreement on the controls is reported (descriptive; expected >= 0.99 from an earlier spot check and R2 I2).
identity_reuse.synthetic_quids: normalized texts needing a run: 10 * quid + v, v = 1..9 in sorted-text order per quid (nm_common.assign_squids); deduplicated across items and checkpoints

pipeline_on_normalized_text.levels: 5 (k05_s0) and 100 (k100). Level 1 is not run: N is fitted on the 5% list, so N + a 1% arm is not a 1%-level method.
pipeline_on_normalized_text.arms: RULE_5, RULE_100, S_5, S_100 (Ranker, LightGBM seeds 0-2) from the structural rebuild (frozen R1 rob_build.py sha256 0400d972..., CPU); Parser P_5, P_100 (frozen pk_infer.py + pk_execute.py, adapters P_k05_s0_s0/ep1 and P_k100_s0/ep0.5, tau off, fallback = the variant's own S_k lists, 3 S seeds); Reader G_5, G_100 (frozen gk_infer.py, adapters G_k05_s0_ordS_s0/ep2, G_k100_ordS_s0/ep1, order S). Exactly the R3 jobBC3 invocations (vLLM gpu_mem 0.40) on one card of the GPU host, one container per arm (nm_run_card.sh).
pipeline_on_normalized_text.integrity: nm_verify.py: sha256 of every frozen adapter, code and prediction file listed in the R3 freezes (expected_sha_r3.json, expected_sha_dev.json) and of rob_build.py before any run; mismatch = STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY
pipeline_on_normalized_text.per_question_hits: S and P: mean over the 3 S-seed files; RULE and G: single file

dev_selection.data: dev_sel2000 ORIG (2,000 questions) and DEV_ACCEPTED paraphrases (1,762) only (inputs/dev_items.jsonl sha256 31f7c23b...); dev gold of these quids; never R1, R2, R3 or test
dev_selection.candidates: 3 checkpoints (ep0.5, ep1, ep2) x 4 guard settings = 12 configurations; one normalizer decoding session over all dev items for the 3 checkpoints; G_5 and P_5 run once on the union of distinct changed texts
dev_selection.objective: J = 0.5 * Hits@1(N + P_5, DEV_ACCEPTED paraphrases; mean over 3 S seeds) + 0.5 * Hits@1(N + G_5, DEV_ACCEPTED paraphrases)
dev_selection.constraint: dev-original loss <= 0.3 points for BOTH arms: Hits@1(P_5, dev ORIG 2,000) - Hits@1(N + P_5, dev ORIG) <= 0.003 and the same for G_5 (baselines = frozen dev_sel2000 hits)
dev_selection.choice: max J among feasible configurations; ties (|dJ| < 0.0005) -> earlier checkpoint, then guard B before A, then larger tau (closer to the baseline). No feasible configuration -> the one with the smallest dev-original loss (same tie order), flagged CONSTRAINT_UNMET; the test pass then still runs and every outcome label carries the flag (nm_common.objective / select)
dev_selection.reported_per_candidate: J, Hits@1 dev ORIG and DEV_ACCEPTED for N+P_5 and N+G_5, change rate, fallback rate (by guard reason) and unchanged rate on dev ORIG and on dev paraphrases, exact-match rate of the normalized dev paraphrase vs the original dev question (exact string; and after lower-casing / punctuation removal) - diagnostic
dev_selection.written_before: this rule is registered before any dev normalizer output exists

test_pass.freeze: after selection: N fixed (adapter sha256 recorded); ONE normalizer decoding session over all test items (inputs/test_items.jsonl sha256 52d96760...: 54,584 official test questions + 578 R3 PRIMARY rewrites + 569 R1 P3 accepted rewrites + 570 R2 accepted rewrites = 56,301 inputs); guard applied; the unchanged pipeline run on the texts needing a run; sha256 of every normalized-question file and prediction file written into multitq_normalizer_freeze.json and saved as a file BEFORE the single scoring pass
test_pass.cut_order: GPU items in the order G_5 -> P session (P_5 + P_100) -> G_100; before each item spent + projection <= 4.5 GPU-h else NOT_RUN: G_100 is dropped first, then P_100 (P_5 alone if only it fits); structural arms are CPU and always run
test_pass.scoring: ONE registered pass (nm_score.py, sha256 recorded in the freeze before it runs) with the official multitq_eval.hit_at_k and test.json answers; baseline and method R3 hits computed together in that pass (R3 rule)

statistics.methods: NR = N + RULE, NS = N + S, NP = N + P, NG = N + G; baseline of each = the same frozen arm without N, at the same level
statistics.R3_secondary (registered R3 analysis pla: R3 PRIMARY (578): for each method and level k in {5, 100}: Hits@1 on the full official test (method and baseline), Hits@1 on R3 ORIG and R3 rewrites, drop = ORIG - rewrite per question; c_drop = drop_b - drop_m (H_drop, 'm loses less'), c_rw = Hits@1_RW,m - Hits@1_RW,b (H_rw, 'm scores higher on R3'); r3_common.method_tests: paired Poisson(1) bootstrap of the mean contrast (r2_common.summarise), B = 10,000, seed 20261118, one-sided p = share of bootstrap means <= 0, two-sided 95% percentile CI and one-sided 95% lower bound; Holm within each method over its 4 tests (2 levels x {H_drop, H_rw}) at alpha 0.05; SUPPORTED / NOT_SUPPORTED. ORIG of the baseline = frozen official test predictions; ORIG of the method = N applied to the original question (from the full-test pass).
statistics.original_test_cost: for every arm and level: d(q) = Hits@1(N + arm) - Hits@1(arm) over all 54,584 test questions; paired Poisson(1) bootstrap (r2_common.summarise, B = 10,000, seed 20261118), two-sided 95% CI; label NONINFERIOR iff CI lower bound >= -0.003, INFERIOR iff CI upper bound < -0.003, else INCONCLUSIVE; Hits@10 reported alongside
statistics.R1_R2_descriptive: the same contrasts on R1 P3 accepted rewrites (569; generator = the API LLM (API LLM)) and R2 accepted rewrites (570; generator Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct-AWQ = the generator of the normalizer's training paraphrases -> labelled GENERATOR_MATCHED); B = 10,000, seed 20261118; unadjusted one-sided p, no labels; ORIG reference = frozen official test predictions (the R3 convention; the registered R1/R2 drops used re-run ORIG predictions, so their per-arm drops can differ slightly and are never replaced)
statistics.gold_free_diagnostics: change / fallback / unchanged rates by input class (test ORIG, R3, R1, R2) and guard reason; share of rewrites normalized to exactly their original question

outcome_labels.per_arm_level: ROBUSTNESS_GAIN iff H_rw SUPPORTED (Holm, R3) and original_test_cost NONINFERIOR; GAIN_WITH_COST iff H_rw SUPPORTED and cost not NONINFERIOR; NO_GAIN iff H_rw NOT_SUPPORTED. H_drop is reported next to it. With CONSTRAINT_UNMET at selection every label carries that flag.
outcome_labels.status: R3 evidence is SECONDARY (robustness), never the paper's primary test result

selection_discipline: every checkpoint, guard variant and threshold chosen on dev_sel2000 ORIG + DEV_ACCEPTED only, by the registered objective above; no change after any test, R1, R2 or R3 number is read; anything not listed here is POST_HOC and not decision-relevant; registered results of other tracks are never changed

stop_rules.STOP_GPU_CAP: cut order above; unrun items NOT_RUN and declared
stop_rules.STOP_GPU_SHARING: one container per card; any other compute process on the card -> wait (nm_run_card.sh)
stop_rules.STOP_TEST_INTEGRITY: frozen adapter / code / prediction sha256 mismatch
stop_rules.STOP_PIPELINE_DRIFT: identity-control I1 top-1 < 0.995 for RULE or S at any level
stop_rules.STOP_TOKENIZER: probe prompt ids differ between training and inference
stop_rules.DEADLINE: all normalizer compute finished by Fri 21 Nov 2026 (R3 rule deadline); unfinished items NOT_RUN

deviations_known_at_registration: Level 1 not run (N is fitted on the 5% list).
R1 P1 / P2 deterministic perturbations not included (the task's rewrite probes are the LLM rewrites R1 P3, R2, R3).
Training paraphrases cover 18,000 of the 19,339 5% questions (A3 prefix); 17,146 mechanically valid are used.
Normalizer decoding runs on the second GPU host RTX 4090 (vLLM 0.10.2 image) while the frozen arms run on the GPU host; the frozen arms' hardware is unchanged.
